title: "SQL Playground"
subtitle: "Query the public spending dataset with SQL"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

Select a preset query or write your own SQL. All queries run locally in your browser
via DuckDB-Wasm — no data leaves your machine.

<div class="control-bar">
  <label for="preset-select">Preset:</label>
  <select id="preset-select"></select>
  <button id="run-btn">Run (Ctrl+Enter)</button>
</div>

<textarea id="sql-editor" class="sql-editor" rows="8" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
<div id="query-info" class="query-info"></div>
<div id="results" class="results-table"></div>

::: {.callout-note}
## Available Tables
- `'data_public/spend_monthly_category.parquet'` — columns: `month`, `category_l1`, `category_l2`, `amount`
- `'data_public/income_monthly.parquet'` — columns: `month`, `income_amount`
- `'data_public/events_public.parquet'` — columns: `event_id`, `label`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `type`
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Tips
- Use **Ctrl+Enter** (or Cmd+Enter on Mac) to run queries quickly.
- Results are limited to 500 rows for display performance.
- DuckDB supports standard SQL — try `PIVOT`, window functions, or `EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month)`.
:::

```{=html}
<script type="module">
import { initPlayground } from "./assets/js/sql_playground.js";

initPlayground({
  presetSelect: document.getElementById("preset-select"),
  textarea: document.getElementById("sql-editor"),
  runBtn: document.getElementById("run-btn"),
  resultsDiv: document.getElementById("results"),
  infoDiv: document.getElementById("query-info"),
});
</script>
```
